_metadata.description: Hedge pair mapping for Tradier stock trading. Since you cannot short the same symbol you're long on Tradier, hedging requires finding correlated symbols in the same sector and opening the opposite position.
_metadata.usage: To hedge LONG AAPL: SHORT one of same_sector peers (MSFT, GOOGL, QQQ). Or buy inverse_etf (SQQQ). To hedge SHORT AAPL: LONG one of same_sector peers.
_metadata.correlation_notes: est_correlation is an estimated correlation coefficient (0-1). Higher = better hedge. Inverse ETFs have negative correlation (move opposite).
_metadata.inverse_etf_notes: inverse_etf lists all known inverse ETFs for the sector. inverse_etf_in_universe = already tradeable. inverse_etf_needs_adding = would need to be added to symbols_tradier.json.
_metadata.non_shortable_notes: Symbols marked shortable=false cannot be sold short on Tradier. They can only be hedged by shorting a correlated peer.
